== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. '''Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.''' The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-00-Commence_Primary_Ignition.png]]), the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-commenceprimaryignition-pre.gif]]) and the Master List (2013) show the original text of [[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured 21 July 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html); 11 December 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html); 11 January 2013 (https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html); also on the Virtual master list (VMasterType) to 11 January 2013. Typos, capitals and punctuation are kept as published; icons the list writes out in words are drawn as the printed slip draws them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “If Death Star orbits Alderaan (and [Virtual Block 7] Central Core on table), deploy on Death Star and fire Superlaser at Alderaan; it is 'blown away.' Once during your control phase, if Death Star orbiting a planet (except a Rebel Base) without related sites, may fire Superlaser at planet (regardless of Objective restrictions) as follows: Draw destiny. Add 2 if you control that system. If (destiny + Y - Z) > 8, target is 'blown away' and opponent loses 4 Force from Life Force. Y = total Death Star sites where opponent has no presence. Z = total sites at Yavin 4.”
* '''Made:''' 10 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 73) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, slip label and copyright line as printed) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>.spec.json</code> next to the image in the batch C1 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
